title: Penetration appeared without Swann ever discussing it beforehand
summary: Joe McMoneagle tells of Penetration appeared without Swann ever discussing it beforehand, about 1998 at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: penetration came right out of the clear blue never spoke a word of it

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a remote viewer who worked in the US government's psychic research, told podcast host Jesse Michels about Penetration, a book by his fellow psychic Ingo Swann that came out around 1998. McMoneagle says the book came "right out of the clear blue," and that Swann had never said a word about it to him beforehand.
